name: Top Speed
author: Addicting Games
description: Top Speed is an action game where you race through traffic! There’s no traffic cop around and you’re in a rush to get to your destination. Weave in and out of traffic without hitting other cars. Some cars stay in their lanes but some of them will switch without signaling. The nerve! Earn and collect coins as you get further and further with each play. Use the coins to unlock all the character skins for your car so that you can choose from many options. The car game will speed up as you zoom through traffic and it becomes difficult to avoid bad drivers. Drive as far as you can each time to earn cash and get a better chance of landing on the leaderboards. Do not stress if you don’t get too far at first. This is the kind of online game to play over and over again to beat your own score. You are your own competition in this fun action game!
